tool.name: Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation
tool.description: retrieve public evidence for one GRCh38 germline variant

param.name: query
param.label: GRCh38 germline variant
param.help: One supported SNV or simple indel as HGVS, rsID, or genomic notation.

tool.help:
Returns the canonical public Folklore result for professional variant review. It does not evaluate patient context and is not diagnosis, treatment advice, or a standalone clinical report. Do not submit patient or private data.
Documentation: https://folklore.helena.bio/integrations
